sn6.6:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno.
sn6.6:1.3: atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṃ dvārabāhaṃ upanissāya aṭṭhaṃsu. atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā suddhāvāsaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca
sn6.6:1.4: akālo kho tāva mārisa bhagavantaṃ payirupāsituṃ
sn6.6:1.6: amu ca brahmaloko iddho ceva phīto ca brahmā ca tattha pamādavihāraṃ viharati
sn6.6:1.7: āyāma mārisa yena so brahmaloko tenupasaṅkamissāma upasaṅkamitvā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejeyyāmāti.
sn6.6:1.8: evaṃ mārisāti kho suddhāvāso paccekabrahmā subrahmuno paccekabrahmuno paccassosi.
sn6.6:2.1: atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso …pe… evameva bhagavato purato antarahitā tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahesuṃ.
sn6.6:2.2: addasā kho so brahmā te brahmāno dūratova āgacchante disvāna te brahmāno etadavoca
sn6.6:2.3: handa kuto nu tumhe mārisā āgacchathāti.
sn6.6:2.4: atha kho mayaṃ mārisa āgacchāma tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santikā gacchasi
sn6.6:2.5: pana tvaṃ mārisa tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
sn6.6:3.1: evaṃ vutte kho so brahmā taṃ vacanaṃ anadhivāsento sahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ abhinimminitvā subrahmānaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca
sn6.6:3.2: passasi me no tvaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:3.3: passāmi kho tyāhaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:3.4: so khvāhaṃ mārisa evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo kassa aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissāmīti.
sn6.6:4.1: atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā dvisahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ abhinimminitvā brahmānaṃ etadavoca
sn6.6:4.2: passasi me no tvaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ taṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:4.3: passāmi kho tyāhaṃ mārisa evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāvanti.
sn6.6:4.4: tayā ca kho mārisa mayā ca sveva bhagavā mahiddhikataro ceva mahānubhāvo ca
sn6.6:4.5: āgaccheyyāsi tvaṃ mārisa tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
sn6.6:4.6: atha kho so brahmā subrahmānaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn6.6:7.1: atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejetvā tatthevantaradhāyiṃsu.
sn6.6:7.2: agamāsi ca 2 so brahmā aparena samayena bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
